blocks.raw: # Getting Sandbox Access
blocks.text: Getting Sandbox Access

blocks.raw: ## Getting access to our Sandbox
blocks.text: Getting access to our Sandbox

blocks.raw: To test out our API or Customer Portal you will need to register for access to our sandbox environment. To do so, complete the form [here](https://share.hsforms.com/1VPuWUUZPSSW4Npn-0BKqew1co3o).
blocks.text: To test out our API or Customer Portal you will need to register for access to our sandbox environment. To do so, complete the form here.

blocks.raw: ## Sandbox default functionality
blocks.text: Sandbox default functionality

blocks.raw: Your sandbox environment will be configured as a Direct Customer and you'll be provided with:
blocks.text: Your sandbox environment will be configured as a Direct Customer and you'll be provided with:

blocks.raw:
* API credentials
* Admin user credentials
* A single GBP account credited with £50,000 of fictitious money
blocks.text: API credentialsAdmin user credentialsA single GBP account credited with £50,000 of fictitious money

blocks.raw: Within the Sandbox environment, you can:
blocks.text: Within the Sandbox environment, you can:

blocks.raw:
* Manage users
* Manage accounts
* Manage payment rules
* Manage beneficiaries
* Manage payments
* Credit your accounts with additional fictitious money via the Sandbox only [credit endpoint](https://modulr.readme.io/reference/createpayments)
blocks.text: Manage usersManage accountsManage payment rulesManage beneficiariesManage paymentsCredit your accounts with additional fictitious money via the Sandbox only credit endpoint

blocks.raw: ## Sandbox functionality that can be enabled
blocks.text: Sandbox functionality that can be enabled

blocks.raw: We can configure the sandbox environment as a Partner such that you can:
blocks.text: We can configure the sandbox environment as a Partner such that you can:

blocks.raw: * Manage customers
blocks.text: Manage customers

blocks.raw: We can also enable the ability to:
blocks.text: We can also enable the ability to:

blocks.raw:
* Create EUR (SEPA) accounts
* Manage Direct Debit collections
* Manage Virtual cards
* Manage payment approvals (including creating admin users with approval permissions)
* Allow waiting for funds before payments are made
blocks.text: Create EUR (SEPA) accountsManage Direct Debit collectionsManage Virtual cardsManage payment approvals (including creating admin users with approval permissions)Allow waiting for funds before payments are made

blocks.raw: ## API Base URL
blocks.text: API Base URL

blocks.raw: Within the Sandbox environment there are two authentication methods available:
blocks.text: Within the Sandbox environment there are two authentication methods available:

blocks.raw: If you are accessing our API directly from your code and have set-up HMAC [(Instructions here](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/authentication)) on how to calculate the hmac value are here: [Authentication](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/authentication)), the URL you should use for the Modulr API sandbox environment is:
blocks.text: If you are accessing our API directly from your code and have set-up HMAC (Instructions here) on how to calculate the hmac value are here: Authentication), the URL you should use for the Modulr API sandbox environment is:

blocks.raw: * <https://api-sandbox.modulrfinance.com/api-sandbox/>
blocks.text: https://api-sandbox.modulrfinance.com/api-sandbox/

blocks.raw: If you wish to try our API's **without** first setting up HMAC, you can use our token URL instead using your **API Key**:
blocks.text: If you wish to try our API's without first setting up HMAC, you can use our token URL instead using your API Key:

blocks.raw: * <https://api-sandbox.modulrfinance.com/api-sandbox-token/>
blocks.text: https://api-sandbox.modulrfinance.com/api-sandbox-token/

blocks.raw:
> ❗️ Authentication in Production
>
> HMAC is the only authentication method used in Production. Use of the token is only in our Sandbox environment.
>
> You will be provided with the production environment URL during onboarding to the production service.
>
> Failing to use the correct URLs may result in requests being rejected or silently ignored

blocks.raw: ## Sandbox Customer Portal Access
blocks.text: Sandbox Customer Portal Access

blocks.raw: With your Sandbox account, you will have access to the Sandbox Modulr Portal. You can learn more about using this portal in our [Modulr Portal Knowledge Base here](https://knowledge.modulrfinance.com/knowledge-hub/using-the-modulr-portal).
blocks.text: With your Sandbox account, you will have access to the Sandbox Modulr Portal. You can learn more about using this portal in our Modulr Portal Knowledge Base here.
